scope: Additive Home Village TH18 Super Yeti direct-baseline integration. Earlier frozen references and the separate Electromite mechanics audit remain unmodified.
game_version: The upstream payload is commit 62b019df868f9decb49e97a0ff5ae15fb27af9ba. The added L8 observation identifies client build 18.600.3.

sources.title: Mini Spotlight Event: Super Yeti!
sources.limitations: The announcement establishes the Super Yeti as a real Home Village Super Troop but publishes no level values or deterministic Electromite contract.

sources.title: Super Yeti - Clash of Clans Wiki
sources.limitations: The dated table supplies parent L1-L8 HP and DPS, housing, target type, range, cadence and movement. It does not publish an Electromite spawn or chain tick contract.

sources.title: Super Yeti and Super Yeti/Electromite
sources.limitations: The Electromite page says every 400 parent damage, while the parent page says 400 then every 800. Neither page identifies a build or the required spawn, chain, target, and lifecycle timing.

support.note: Core runs the dated source-backed parent direct baseline. Electromites are not materialized because the available public descriptions conflict on their threshold and omit a deterministic lifecycle.

changed_values.previous_state: Catalogued-only L3-L7 parent with no Core identifier and no TH18 L8 record.
changed_values.replacement: L3-L8 source-backed parent direct baseline materializes through the shared Core path. The L8 observation is hash-pinned to a dated game-file table.
changed_values.justification: The parent combat values and cadence are independently usable. Electromite behaviour remains absent because secondary sources conflict on threshold and omit a reproducible lifecycle.

known_uncertainties: No primary source publishes the Super Yeti or Electromite level values and mechanics used here are secondary.
Public secondary pages conflict on Electromite spawning, either every 400 parent damage or first 400 then every 800.

No version-identified source defines Electromite child level mapping, spawn position, spawn time, chain geometry, target selection, self-destruction delay, Wall jump path, trap interaction, or asset path.
The Super Yeti L8 Town Hall and Laboratory requirements are not published by the dated parent table.
conclusion: Super Yeti direct parent baseline is executable through Core, CLI, Viewer and RL. Electromite spawning and all related effects remain deliberately disabled and incomplete.
